# cpu816-backdrop regression fixture

This design is retained for independent browser/compiler regression coverage.
It is not a bundled Example preset and is not shipped in the static site.
See [fixture setup](../README.md) for import instructions and the
[integration guide](../../../docs/cpu816-backdrop.md) for hardware contracts, timing,
expected outputs, measurements and validation.

The CPU sources retain their pinned Apple-IIgs_MiSTer provenance in
[UPSTREAM.md](../cpu816/UPSTREAM.md) and [GPL license](../cpu816/LICENSE).
Preserve those notices and corresponding-source obligations when distributing
combined designs or generated simulators. The original board and ROM sources
are also GPL-3.0-or-later. No commercial game or firmware ROM is included.
